llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究SLM制备的高熵合金的微观结构和力学性能，未涉及生物医学植入物或应力屏蔽问题。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical implant context, no porous structure for osseointegration, no stress shielding or fatigue evaluation, no surface roughness or biocompatibility testing.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究AlCoCrFeNi2.1共晶高熵合金经SLM后的独特双相微观结构和孔隙率对力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔化制备合金，通过调控工艺参数获得不同孔隙率，并进行微观结构表征和力学测试。
summary_zh.result: 双相微观结构和孔隙率显著影响合金的强度和塑性，优化工艺可获得优异综合力学性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过扫描电镜、X射线衍射和力学实验验证微观结构与性能关系。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of unique duplex microstructure and porosity on the mechanical properties of AlCoCrFeNi2.1 eutectic high-entropy alloys fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Samples were fabricated by SLM with varying process parameters, characterized by SEM, XRD, and EBSD, and tested under compression and tension.
summary_en.result: The duplex microstructure and porosity significantly influence strength and ductility, with optimal parameters yielding balanced mechanical performance.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing combined with microstructural characterization validated the relationship between processing, structure, and properties.

papers.title: Study on composite hydrogel mixture of calcium alginate/gelatin/kappa carrageenan for 3D bioprinting
papers.abstract: Regenerative medicine and tissue engineering are continuously advancing and utilizing new technologies to provide reliable solutions for replacing damaged tissues. Unlike subtractive manufacturing, additive manufacturing became an answer for creating complex shapes for many fields, such as tissue engineering, which requires the need to create body parts that are not geometrically simple. Three-dimensional (3D) bioprinting technology is a great additive manufacturing tool that will significantly benefit the field of regenerative medicine and tissue engineering once precision and feasibility are achieved. Printing a 3D structure narrows the range of material choices to meet the biomaterials criteria, including biocompatibility, biodegradability, printability, and low cytotoxicity. Hydrogels meet all requirements for biomaterials; however, they have weak mechanical properties that are hard to control, making it challenging to print a scaffold precisely, restricting their chance of being used as a potential reliable 3D bioprinting material. In this paper, composite scaffolds composed of calcium alginate/gelatin/κ-carrageenan are printed using an extrusion-based 3D bioprinter. Different concentrations of all three hydrogels are prepared and crosslinked with calcium chloride to transform it from sodium alginate/gelatin/κ-carrageenan to calcium alginate/gelatin/κ-carrageenan, then tested for their strength in tension. Printability is also tested for different concentrations to find the best printing parameters in terms of pressure, print speed, layer height, and printing temperature. The composite hydrogel mixture composed of 2.2% (w/v) calcium alginate/1% (w/v) gelatin/4% (w/v) κ-carrageenan exhibited a higher modulus of elasticity compared to the other tested concentrations and is printable using a 0.864 mm nozzle diameter, 62 °C printing temperature, and 48.2 kPa printing pressure.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文不涉及任何AI方法或智能控制，仅关注水凝胶配方的实验优化，与AI生物打印方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper contains no AI integration into bioprinting workflow, no experimental validation of AI models, and no advancement from observation to autonomous decision.

summary_zh.motivation: 寻找机械性能可调、可打印的水凝胶复合材料
summary_zh.method: 实验制备不同浓度的海藻酸钙/明胶/卡拉胶复合水凝胶，测试拉伸强度与可打印性
summary_zh.result: 2.2%钙藻酸盐/1%明胶/4%卡拉胶混合物弹性模量最高且可打印
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸试验和可打印性参数测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To identify a hydrogel composite with tunable mechanical properties and good printability for 3D bioprinting.
summary_en.method: Composite scaffolds of calcium alginate/gelatin/κ-carrageenan at various concentrations were prepared via extrusion-based bioprinting and crosslinked with calcium chloride, then evaluated for tensile strength and printability.
summary_en.result: The mixture with 2.2% (w/v) calcium alginate, 1% (w/v) gelatin, and 4% (w/v) κ-carrageenan exhibited the highest modulus of elasticity and was printable at specific parameters.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through mechanical testing and printability parameter optimization.

papers.title: Deep learning-based prediction of osseointegration for dental implant using plain radiography.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: In this study, we investigated whether deep learning-based prediction of osseointegration of dental implants using plain radiography is possible. METHODS: Panoramic and periapical radiographs of 580 patients (1,206 dental implants) were used to train and test a deep learning model. Group 1 (338 patients, 591 dental implants) included implants that were radiographed immediately after implant placement, that is, when osseointegration had not yet occurred. Group 2 (242 patients, 615 dental implants) included implants radiographed after confirming successful osseointegration. A dataset was extracted using random sampling and was composed of training, validation, and test sets. For osseointegration prediction, we employed seven different deep learning models. Each deep-learning model was built by performing the experiment 10 times. For each experiment, the dataset was randomly separated in a 60:20:20 ratio. For model evaluation, the specificity, sensitivity, accuracy, and AUROC (Area under the receiver operating characteristic curve) of the models was calculated. RESULTS: The mean specificity, sensitivity, and accuracy of the deep learning models were 0.780-0.857, 0.811-0.833, and 0.799-0.836, respectively. Furthermore, the mean AUROC values ranged from to 0.890-0.922. The best model yields an accuracy of 0.896, and the worst model yields an accuracy of 0.702. CONCLUSION: This study found that osseointegration of dental implants can be predicted to some extent through deep learning using plain radiography. This is expected to complement the evaluation methods of dental implant osseointegration that are currently widely used.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文聚焦于口腔种植体的骨整合深度学习预测，与增材制造生物医学材料方向无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not involve LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing, fatigue, or porous structure design; it is purely a clinical imaging AI study.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索利用平片放射影像通过深度学习预测牙种植体骨整合的可行性。
summary_zh.method: 使用580名患者的1206个种植体影像，训练并测试七个深度学习模型。
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床放射影像数据集，随机分割训练/验证/测试。

summary_en.motivation: Investigate whether deep learning can predict dental implant osseointegration from plain radiographs.
summary_en.method: Seven deep learning models were trained and tested on panoramic and periapical radiographs from 580 patients (1206 implants).
summary_en.result: The best model achieved accuracy of 0.896 and AUROC values ranging from 0.890 to 0.922.
summary_en.validation: Clinical dataset with random 60:20:20 split and 10-fold experiments.
